tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: Render a public web page and return it as an image (or a PDF). Uses one screenshot of the account quota; cache hits and failed renders are free. Prefer jpeg or webp to keep the image small. A result over 6 MB comes back as a download link (valid for about a day) instead of inline data.

tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: List the device presets accepted by the viewport_device argument of take_screenshot. Needs no access key.
